# Plutone

> Plutone ("Let's relight the shop windows") is a service based in Treviso, Italy, that gives new life to vacant shops and commercial premises in the historic centre by hosting temporary projects: pop-up stores, short-term shops, exhibitions, events and window displays. It connects owners of empty commercial spaces with people looking for a space to rent for a short period, from a few days to several months, with no long-term commitment.

Area served: Treviso, historic centre. Address: Via Montello 7A, 31100 Treviso (TV), Italy. E-mail: plutone.treviso@gmail.com

The full website is also available in Italian: https://plutone.vercel.app/llms.txt

## For those looking for a space in Treviso
- [Open a Space](https://plutone.vercel.app/en/clienti.html): temporary rental of a shop (retail space) or just a display window in Treviso, to open a business, a pop-up store, an exhibition or an event. Duration of your choice, no commitment, organisational support, lower costs than opening a business on your own, low risk to test an idea.

## For owners of vacant commercial premises
- [List a Property](https://plutone.vercel.app/proprietari.html) (page in Italian): the owner entrusts Plutone with the whole premises or just the window. Temporary contracts with advance payment and deposit, additional income, no long-term commitment, property kept in good condition and free to be let permanently whenever the owner wishes.

## Opening a shop in December and January
December and January are among the best months for retail: Christmas gifts, markets, New Year and winter sales bring many visitors to the historic centre of Treviso. With Plutone you can open a temporary shop, a Christmas pop-up store or a display window just for the holidays and the sales, without a long contract. The renter chooses the duration, from a few days to several months, with no commitment at all: in December and January you can start with just a few days. For owners it is a chance to earn from a vacant shop in the busiest months. Interested? Write to plutone.treviso@gmail.com or use the Open a Space and List a Property pages.
